title: Nf Opt Round4 Crt
objective: Batch modified Round-4 modular Krylov and CRT reconstruction with exact bounds and annihilation certificates, preserving dynamic fallback and vector010 exactness

handoff.summary: Implemented source-transparent varying-prime Krylov batches, two-level exact CRT, coefficient-bound and exact-annihilation certificates, deterministic certified-prime reuse, a compiled Horner certificate, scalar/direct crossover fallback, focused randomized/corruption/CPython/FLINT differentials, and a vector010 benchmark. Exact vector010 construction fell from the 56-76s baseline range to 27.7-28.3s in loaded runs; all characteristic calls account for about 5.8s and the batched CRT path about 4.9s. Exact HNF, index, discriminant, 67 characteristic calls, 24 modular calls, and Ford-Letard e=16/f=2 remain certified.
risks: The compiler support commit 6cac3769 must be integrated before this kernel; it provides borrowed UInt64Buffer exact-kernel lowering and Integer modulo uint64.
The package architecture byte budget needs an integration-lane increase or source split; this lane intentionally did not edit the central package registry.
The independent verify_round4_local_result call still costs about 25s and is owned by the Round-2 verification lane, not this CRT path.
next_steps: Integrate commits 690f99cf, 75534a9c, f003aee2, and 849961ad after d43fafaf.
Register the focused test and benchmark centrally, adjust the package byte budget, then run pnpm test:native and pnpm architecture:check on the integrated compiler/source tree.
Treat the remaining roughly 22s non-characteristic construction boundary as NumberFieldElement multiplication/reduction and exact field quotient work; do not widen CRT correctness bounds.
